status: before v2 GPU validation, baseline collection, editor search and all held-out scoring
complete_search: Three completed valid candidate evaluations and deliberate finish; score identity plus unique recorded accepted round incumbents.
partial_search_with_completed_evaluation: If at least one valid proposal evaluation completed, freeze all actually recorded accepted round incumbents and an explicit no-more-search declaration. Score only these plus the identity comparison. Label the search partial and never fabricate missing rounds.
zero_completed_proposals_or_invalid_runt: Skip v2 held-out scoring; retain failure/partial records, exact failed costs and no-more-search closure. The amended original v1.1 scoring remains available.
heldout_capacity: 128*(1+U2) for an eligible closed search; zero for a skipped v2 final. U2 counts distinct actually deployed edited accepted incumbents.
feedback_guard: Close all v1 and v2 searches and freeze every candidate hash before either version held-out outcomes are inspected or used for writing new editor instructions.
